1.consolidated_definition: Planta herbácea anual de hasta 60 cm de altura, de hojas simples, alternas, inflorescencia axilar, flores blancas y fruto con numerosas semillas; tiene propiedades medicinales. Boraginaceae; Heliotropium portoricense.
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Annual herbaceous plant reaching up to 60 cm in height, with simple, alternate leaves, axillary inflorescence, white flowers, and fruit containing numerous seeds; it has medicinal properties.

Family: Boraginaceae; Species: Heliotropium portoricense.
